decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established drainage range, the black-finish line fits the firm's design-led strategy and, with no clear sign of underperformance in a growing market, is worth retaining under available organisational slack.

The seamless-covering shower channel was given dedicated market presentation, aligns closely with the core business, and likely meets aspiration levels well enough to justify continuation rather than resource reallocation.

Although somewhat more uncertain technically, the pump-assisted shower drainage solution builds on existing know-how and supports future-ready, barrier-free applications, so boundedly rational management would keep it while results are still being learned.

The tileable floor drain with grating is strongly connected to the firm's core offer and received dedicated presentation, so without evidence of a shortfall below aspirations there is little reason to drop it after only one year.

The stainless steel design drain grate extends the firm's aesthetics-and-engineering positioning with limited distance from existing capabilities, making continuation the prudent choice in the absence of negative performance signals.
